content.rendered:
Press & Features

GUESTPIX™ has been featured in leading global publications including The Bridal Journey, 7News, Daily Mail, Who Magazine, Yahoo Finance, Financial Review, and many more. Our innovative photo sharing platform for events, covers weddings, parties, funerals, and business events. GUESTPIX™ has been recognized for its privacy-first approach, customizable QR codes, and innovative features that make capturing memories easy and secure.

If you have a media or press inquiry, we’d love to chat!

Submit Your Inquiry
